arcaneresearch.AIR.name: Air
arcaneresearch.AIR.text: Créé un souffle d'air repoussant les choses en arrière, mais ne fait que peu de dégats.
arcaneresearch.BOLT.name: Éclair
arcaneresearch.BOLT.text: Envoie directement la magie sur votre cible sous la forme d'un éclair d'énergie concentré. L'effet est instantané mais la portée est limité a 16 blocs.
arcaneresearch.BREAK.name: Casser
arcaneresearch.BREAK.text: Invoque les énergies disruptive qui mettent en morceau la plupart des matériaux.
arcaneresearch.CLOUD.name: Nuage
arcaneresearch.CLOUD.text: Créé un nuage de magie persistant affectant tout se trouvant en son sein.
arcaneresearch.CURSE.name: Maudire
arcaneresearch.CURSE.text: Invoque la puissance de l'entropie pour rompre et nuire à la créature ciblée.
arcaneresearch.EARTH.name: Terre
arcaneresearch.EARTH.text: Lance une tempête de shrapnel terrestres, causant des dégats significatifs et pouvant casser les blocks les plus fragiles.
arcaneresearch.EXCHANGE.name: Échange
arcaneresearch.EXCHANGE.text: Échange un type de bloc dans le monde avec un autre.
arcaneresearch.FIRE.name: Feu
arcaneresearch.FIRE.text: Lance des flammes sur votre cible et l'embrase.
arcaneresearch.FLUX.name: Flux
arcaneresearch.FLUX.text: Cet effet conjure des vis bruts et non focalisés pour déchirer les créatures vivantes (ou mortes). Cette énergie ne peux intéragir avec les objets inanimés, mais contourne cependant les armures classiques.
arcaneresearch.FROST.name: Gel
arcaneresearch.FROST.text: Jete un froid glaçant sur votre cible, lui infligeant des dégats et le gelant. Transforme l'eau en glace et ralenti les créatures.
arcaneresearch.HEAL.name: Soigne
arcaneresearch.HEAL.text: Cet effet soigne les créatures vivantes et blesse les morts-vivants.
arcaneresearch.MINE.name: Mine arcanique
arcaneresearch.MINE.text: Pose une construction mystique explosant lorsqu'une entité hostile passe a proximité, relachant les effets dessus.
arcaneresearch.PLAN.name: Planifier
arcaneresearch.PLAN.text: Vous permet de planifier exactement quels blocs seront affecté.
arcaneresearch.PROJECTILE.name: Projectile
arcaneresearch.PROJECTILE.text: Réuni l'énergie du focus en une orbe magique que vous pouvez lancer. ce projectile se déplace lentement et est affecté par la gravité.
arcaneresearch.RIFT.name: Faille
arcaneresearch.RIFT.text: Transfert la matière dans une réalité alternative, laissant un 'trou' temporairement dans lequel vous pouvez vous déplacer.
arcaneresearch.SCATTER.name: Dispersion
arcaneresearch.SCATTER.text: Sépare une trajectoire unique en plusieurs aléatoires.
arcaneresearch.SPELLBAT.name: Invoquer une chauve-souris de sort
arcaneresearch.SPELLBAT.text: Fait apparaitre une chauve-souris mystique chassant les ennemis et leurs infligeant les effets du focus.
arcaneresearch.SPLITTARGET.name: Objectif divisé
arcaneresearch.SPLITTARGET.text: Divise un objectif en deux moins puissants.
arcaneresearch.SPLITTRAJECTORY.name: Trajectoire divisé
arcaneresearch.SPLITTRAJECTORY.text: Divise une trajectoire en deux moins puissantes.
arcaneresearch.TOUCH.name: Toucher
arcaneresearch.TOUCH.text: Vous permet d'affecter les choses que vous touchez, dans une distance d'environ 4 blocs.
block.arcaneresearch.condenser_lattice_d: Treillis du condenseur de flux bouché
block.arcaneresearch.smelter_void: Fonderie à essentia en métal du vide
book.start.1: "J'ai eu un des rêves les plus étranges la nuit dernière.\n\nDans le rêve, je prenais trois de ces cristaux que j'ai trouvé, accompagné d'une poignée de redstone et je les écrasais dans un bol en utilisant un silex"
book.start.2: "Les cristaux devaient être de type différents, mais si je faisait tout correctement, le résultat était une sorte de poudre brillante étrange.\n\nDans le rêve, j'ai pris la poudre et l'ai dispersé sur une bibliothèque, mais je me suis réveillé avant de voir la fin du rêve."
book.start.3: "Je me demande, devrai-je faire ce que le rêve m'as montré ?\n\nJ'ai l'impression que la poudre allais me révélé quelque chose de merveilleux, mais dangereux."
book.start.title: Rêves étranges
card.analyze.name: Analyser %1$s
card.analyze.text: En analysant complètement les observations faite sur %1$s, vous devriez être capable de mettre en place une théorie basé sur les données collectés. perdez 1 %1$s observation pour progresser de 25 à 50 points de %1$s et 5 points de %2$s.
card.awareness.name: Conscience
card.awareness.text: Vous vous ouvrez au flots de vis autour de vous. Vous comprenez mieux comment il marche et la nature sous-jacente des choses, mais cela vous laisse métaphysiquement vulnérable. Gagnez 20 auromancie. Il y a aussi une chance que vous gagnez de la connaissance eldritch et du warp.
card.balance.name: Théorie universelle
card.balance.text: Une révélation d'un instant vous fait réaliser les points communs et les liens entre tout ce que vous étudiez. Votre progression totale est divisée uniformément entre toute les catégories révélés et valides, et une catégorie supplémentaire gagnera l'entièreté du bonus à la fin.
card.beacon.name: Influence de l'aura
card.beacon.text: Vous pensez que la balise interagie d'une manière ou d'une autre avec l'aura. Vous étudiez cela soigneusement, et même si vous avez rien trouvé cette fois ci, vous avez été inspiré. Vous regagnez 2 inspiration, piochez 1 carte de plus et une catégorie supplémentaire gagnera l'entièreté du bonus à la fin.
card.calibrate.name: Calibrer
card.calibrate.text: Vous prenez un peu de temps pour calibrer correctement vos outils et instruments de mesure. Gagnez 15 artifice et piochez une carte de plus.
card.celestial.name: Études celestes
card.celestial.text: Vous comparez quelques-une de vos notes celestes pour voir des correlations possibles avec votre sujet de recherche principal. Vous progressez de 25 à 50 points de %1$s. Vous pouvez aussi gagner d'autre choses...
card.channel.name: Canaliser de l'essentia %1$s
card.channel.text: Vous mettez en place une expérience simple pour examiner ce qu'il se passe lorsque vous canalisez de l'essentia %1$s pendant l'infusion. Gagnez 25 infusion.
card.concentrate.name: Concentrer
card.concentrate.text: On en apprend souvent beaucoup en concentrant une substance dans sa forme la plus pure. Tentez de concentrer de l'essentia %1$s. Gagnez 15 alchimie et 1 tirage bonus. Il y a aussi une chance que vous gagnez 1 inspiration.
card.curio.name: Étudiez une curiosité
card.curio.text: Même si examiner une curiosité réèle généralement des information intéréssantes, c'est bien mieux de l'étudier dans le cadre d'une recherche contrôlée.
card.darkwhisper.name: Murmures sombres
card.darkwhisper.text: Le cerveau en bocal était très bavard ces derniers temps. Il vous promets des secrets anciens contre toute votre expérience. Pouvez vous lui faire confiance ?
card.dragonegg.name: Études draconiques
card.dragonegg.text: L'aura autour de l'oeuf tourbillone d'énergies étranges et chaotiques. Vous remarquez de temps en temps un ordre étrange au milieu du chaos.
card.enchantment.name: Étudiez l'enchantement
card.enchantment.text: Vous étudiez l'enchantement normal pour voir comment il fonctionne a un niveau fondamental. Vous êtes sûr qu'il partage beaucoup en commun avec les méthodes d'enchantement utilisé en infusion et artifice. Vous perdez 5 niveaux d'experience, mais gagnez 15 à 20 points dans l'infusion et l'auromancy.
card.experimentation.name: Experimentation
card.experimentation.text: vous effectuez quelques expériences au hasard pour voir si vous découvrez quelque chose. progressez de 15 à 30 points dans une catégorie aléatoire.
card.focus.name: Concentration spirituelle
card.focus.text: Vous concentrez votre esprit sur l'énergie magique et spirituelle autour de vous, esperant être plus a l'écoute de ses flux et reflux. Gagnez 15 auromancie et un tirage supplémentaire.
card.glyph.name: Étude des glyphes
card.glyph.text: Vous étudiez les glyphes anciens. Quels secrets Eldritch renferment-ils ? Vous trouvez le langage ancien difficile a comprendre, mais de temps à autre des fragments de vérités se révèle à vous.
card.infuse.name: Infusion experimentale
card.infuse.text: En émmetant des hypothèses sur les résultats de l'infusion de certains objets avec de l'essentia, puis en testant ces résultats, des informations précieuses peuvent êtres aquises. Vous apprendrez beaucoup en combinant de l'essentia %1$s et %2$s puis en étudiant le résultat. Gagnez %3$s infusion.
card.inspired.name: Inspiré
card.inspired.text: Inspiré par votre progression jusqu'à maintenant, votre esprit explore des voies que vous n'ayez pas pris en considération avant. vous gagnez %1$s %2$s.
card.measure.name: Mesure
card.measure.text: Vous prenez le temps de faire des mesures détaillés de différents types d'essentia et des vis potentiels qu'elles contiennent. Gagnez 15 infusion et un tirage bonus.
card.mindmatter.name: L'esprit sur la matière
card.mindmatter.text: Vous éxaminez et démontez soigneusement quelques composants fondamentaux dans l'espoir de trouver de nouvelles manières de les assembler en crétions plus complexes. Gagnez %1$s artifice.
card.notation.name: Notation
card.notation.text: En prenant des notes de vos découvertes jusqu'a présent, vous trouvez quelques erreurs et les corrigez. Vous perdez toute votre progression en %1$s, mais la plupart des pertes sont ajoutés en %2$s.
card.ponder.name: Méditer
card.ponder.text: Vous tenez soigneusement compte de tout ce que vous avez appris jusqu'à présent. Vous gagnez 25 points divisé uniformément entre toute les catégories actives, et tirez une carte de plus.
card.portal.name: Voix de l'au-delà
card.portal.text: Baigné dans la lumière de cet étrange portail, d'étranges pensées envahissent votre conscience. la plupart sont incompréhensibles, mais certaine remplissent votre esprit d'inspirations singulières.
card.reactions.name: Reactions
card.reactions.text: Étudier les réactions entre deux types de vis devrais se montrer bénéfique. Vous devriez étudier ce qu'il se passe quand de l'essentia %1$s réagit avec de l'essentia %2$s. Gagnez 25 alchimie. Il y a aussi une chance que vous gagnez 1 inspiration.
card.realization.name: Réalisation soudaine
card.realization.text: Pendant que vous méditiez sur la nature de l'Eldritch, vous avez soudainement une révélation sur la vraie nature de l'univers. Vous gagnez 15 eldritch et 5 à 10 dans deux catégories aléatoires. Vous gagnerez aussi un peu de warp temporaire. Il y a une chance que vous gagnez aussi du warp normal.
card.reject.name: Rejeter les trouvailles sur %1$s
card.reject.text: Vous réalisez que %1$s n'est pas vital pour vos recherches actuelles. Vous ne progresserez plus en %1$s, ni ne piocherez de carte en relation avec, mais votre progression actuelle restera.
card.rethink.name: Reconsiderer
card.rethink.text: Vous prenez du recul et réévaluez vos trouvailles. Vous vous débarrassez des conclusions éronnés et continuez avec une compréhension nouvelle. Perdez 10 points divisé uniformément entre toute les catégories actives,mais vous regagnez 1 inspiration et piochez 1 carte de plus.
card.revelation.name: Révélation
card.revelation.text: Étudier les Eldritch est une activité dangereuse, mais la connaissance que vous pouvez découvrir vaut souvent le coup. Vous progressez de 30 eldritch et 5 à 10 dans une catégorie aléatoire. Vous gagnerez aussi un peu de warp normal et temporaire,  ainsi qu'une catégorie supplémentaire avec l'entièreté du bonus à la fin.
card.scripting.name: Script
card.scripting.text: Une grande partie de la golémancie consiste à créer des textes arcaniques pour contrôler vos créations. En créant des scripts de test vous pouvez aproffondir votre compréhension. Gagnez 25 golémancie. Cela consome un peu plus de papier et d'encre de la table de recherche.
card.sculpting.name: Sculpture
card.sculpting.text: Vous pouvez aiguiser vos connaissances en créant des figurines animé simple et éphémères. Gagnez 20 golémancie et un tirage bonus.
card.spellbinding.name: Fixation de sort
card.spellbinding.text: Vous liez différents enchantements de test à des restes de cristaux. Ils n'ont aucune utilité pratique, mais vous octroie des connaissances inestimables. Perdez jusqu'a 5 niveaux d'experience, mais gagnez 5 auromancie par niveau perdu.
card.study.name: Étudier %1$s
card.study.text: Une grande partie de la recherche c'est simplement prendre des livres et rassembler le travail. vous étudiez %1$s et progressez de 15 à 25 points.
card.synergy.name: Synergie
card.synergy.text: A la base, la golémancie est un mélange d'alchimie, d'artifice et d'infusion. C'est seulement en comprenant completement comment ces trois disciplines intéragissent entre elles que vous serez capable de maîtriser la golémancie. Perdez 15 points divisé équitablement entre alchimie, artifice et infusion pour gagner 30 golémancie. Une catégorie supplémentaire gagnera l'entièreté du bonus à la fin.
card.synthesis.name: Synthese
card.synthesis.text: Quand de l'essentia se combine pour constituer une forme plus complexe, de nombreuses réactions intriqués et intéréssantes se produisent. Vous aprendrez beaucoup en combinant de l'essentia %1$s avec de l'essentia %2$s, puis en étudiant le résultat. Gagnez 40 alchimie. Il y a aussi une chance que vous gagnez 1 inspiration.
card.tinker.name: Bricoler
card.tinker.text: Vous commencez à bricoler des appareils pour trouver de nouvelles manières de les incorporer dans des création magiques. Gagnez %1$s à %2$s artifice.
card.truth.name: Trouver la vérité
card.truth.text: Vous chercher déséspérément à trouver la vérité caché derrière l'Eldritch et ce que ça pourrait vouloir dire sur le monde. Vous progressez de 10 à 25 Eldritch et piochez une carte de plus. Vous gagnez aussi du warp temporaire.
death.attack.swarm.item: %1$s a été infecté par %2$s en utilisant %3$s
death.attack.taint: %1$s a été infecté par de la corruption
death.attack.taint.player: %1$s a été infecté par de la corruption en luttant contre %2$s
fail.crimsonrites: Ce livre ne contient rien d'autre que des délires fous.
false.start: C'est comme si ça devait marchais, mais il manque quelque chose...
focus.upgrade.alchemistsfire.name: Alchemist's Fire
focus.upgrade.alchemistsfire.text: This increases the potency of the elemental fire in the focus. Any targets set alight will burn for much longer.
focus.upgrade.alchemistsfrost.name: Alchemist's Frost
focus.upgrade.alchemistsfrost.text: This increases the potency of the elemental cold in the focus. When the focus targets or damages a creature it will be chilled and slowed significantly.
focus.upgrade.architect.name: Architect
focus.upgrade.architect.text: This upgrade gives a lot more control over the area certain foci effect. The exact area that will be effected is displayed and you can change the size using the misc wand toggle key (default G). Sneak+G allows you to toggle which dimensions you can change.
focus.upgrade.batbombs.name: Bat Bombs
focus.upgrade.batbombs.text: This upgrade will make the summoned firebats even more volatile. They always explode when they contact their target and the explosion will be a lot more potent than normal.
focus.upgrade.chainlightning.name: Chain Lightning
focus.upgrade.chainlightning.text: This upgrade reduces the speed at which the focus fires bolts, but the damage is increased and the bolt can chain to up to two additional targets.
focus.upgrade.devilbats.name: Devil Bats
focus.upgrade.devilbats.text: With this upgrade applied the summoned bats are larger, tougher and nastier. They will never explode, but keep attacking their target till it expires or they are slain.
focus.upgrade.dowsing.name: Dowsing
focus.upgrade.dowsing.text: This upgrade gives the excavation focus a small chance to mine native clusters instead of normal ores. These clusters usually give double the number of ingots when smelted.
focus.upgrade.earthshock.name: Earth Shock
focus.upgrade.earthshock.text: Instead of a bolt of lightning, the focus now lobs a ball of electrical energy. It inflicts damage in an area around where it hits and leaves the ground dangerously electrified for some time.
focus.upgrade.enlarge.name: Enlarge
focus.upgrade.enlarge.text: This upgrade increases how large an area the focus's powers effect, or increases the number of targets effected.
focus.upgrade.extend.name: Extend
focus.upgrade.extend.text: This upgrade increases the duration of any effects the upgrade might create.
focus.upgrade.fireball.name: Fireball
focus.upgrade.fireball.text: The focus will now produce a explosive ball of fire you can hurl at your foes. The Alchemists Fire upgrade causes it to also set the ground aflame around the point of impact.
focus.upgrade.firebeam.name: Fire Beam
focus.upgrade.firebeam.text: The focus now emits a narrow stream of fire instead of a wide swathe. It burns through anything it touches inflicting massive damage.
focus.upgrade.frugal.name: Frugal
focus.upgrade.frugal.text: This upgrade reduces the vis cost of activating the focus's powers by 10% per level.
focus.upgrade.iceboulder.name: Ice Boulder
focus.upgrade.iceboulder.text: The focus will now create a large boulder of ice. The boulder has a tendancy to bounce around making it deadly in skilled hands.
focus.upgrade.nightshade.name: Nightshade
focus.upgrade.nightshade.text: Normally the Pech's curse focus inflicts one of a small handful of debilitating effects. With this upgrade it will inflict all of them at once.
focus.upgrade.persistant.name: Persistant
focus.upgrade.persistant.text: When the target if this focus dies, disappears or moves out of range, the missile will seek another target of the same type nearby.
focus.upgrade.potency.name: Potency
focus.upgrade.potency.text: This upgrade increases the damage or strength of the focus's powers. The exact damage increase varies from focus to focus, but is usually about 20% per level.
focus.upgrade.scattershot.name: Scattershot
focus.upgrade.scattershot.text: Instead of a single shard of ice, the focus will now fire multiple shards. Each shard does minimal damage, but a concentrated volley of them can do significant damage to a single target.
focus.upgrade.seeker.name: Seeker
focus.upgrade.seeker.text: This upgrade makes the orbs created by the primal focus seek out the nearest living target and not wander all over the place. This makes them a lot more stable which also means they won't do anything unusual beyond exploding.
focus.upgrade.silktouch.name: Silk Touch
focus.upgrade.silktouch.text: Like the enchantment of the same name, this upgrade allows you to pick up harvested blocks as-is instead of gaining the normal drops.
focus.upgrade.sticky.name: Sticky
focus.upgrade.sticky.text: The grapple does not automatically detach when you get close enough - you must manually detach from it.
focus.upgrade.treasure.name: Treasure
focus.upgrade.treasure.text: This upgrade acts like the Fortune or Looting enchantments. It increases the chance of getting more/better loot.
focus.upgrade.vampirebats.name: Vampire Bats
focus.upgrade.vampirebats.text: This upgrade changes the summoned bats into vampire bats. Not only will they suck the life out of their target to replenish their own, but some of the stolen life force is given to their summoner.
golem.addon.text.armored: Confère au golem une durabilité augmentée.
golem.addon.text.fighter: Permet au golem d'engager un combat.
golem.addon.text.hauler: Permet au golem de transporter deux piles au lieu d'une seule.
golem.arm.text.basic: Les bras et mains de golem par défaut. Pas de forces ou de faiblesses particulières.
golem.arm.text.breakers: Ces bras sont terminés par des meuleuses pneumatiques renforcées au diamant.
golem.arm.text.claws: Ces bras sont terminés par des pinces métalliques tranchantes. Fourni avec un module d'aggression intégré.
golem.arm.text.darts: Ces bras sont terminés par des lanceurs de fléchettes. Les fléchettes sont créées magiquement quand il le faut. Fourni avec un module d'aggression intégré.
golem.arm.text.fine: Ces bras sont terminés par des mains délicates et habiles.
golem.head.text.basic: La tête de golem par défaut. Pas de forces ou de faiblesses particulières.
golem.head.text.scout: Le mécanisme d'horloger basique amélioré à l'aide d'yeux biothaumiques.
golem.head.text.smart: Cette tête contient un cerveau biothaumique avancé, conférant au golem des aptitudes supérieures et des capacités d'apprentissage.
golem.head.text.smart_armored: La tête intelligente est améliorée à l'aide de renforcements et de blindages supplémentaires.
golem.head.text.smart_scout: Utilisant à la fois les yeux biothaumiques et le cerveau, cette tête est l'apogée de la biothaumique.
golem.leg.text.climber: Une paire de jambes basique améliorée à l'aide de crampons et d'autres accessoires pour l'ascension verticale.
golem.leg.text.flyer: Un lévitateur arcanique modifié conférant au golem la possibilté de voler. Réduis la vitesse d'un tiers.
golem.leg.text.roller: Une roue unique. Plutôt rapide, mais incapable de sauter ou de monter des pentes abruptes.
golem.leg.text.walker: Une paire de jambes classique. Pas de forces ou de faiblesses particulières.
golem.material.text.brass: Le golem est fait de laiton. Il n'est pas aussi solide que le fer ni aussi résistant au feu. En temps normal le laiton est plus lourd que le fer, mais permet des meilleures méthodes de construction résultant en un cadre bien plus léger.
golem.material.text.clay: Le golem est fait d'argile cuite. Sans être un matériau particulièrement solide, il permet au golem d'être résistant au feu et relativement léger.
golem.material.text.iron: Le golem est fait de fer. Il est solide et ignifugé, mais lourd.
golem.material.text.thaumium: Le golem est fait de thaumium. Il partage beaucoup de caractéristiques avec le fer, bien qu'étant plus solide et résistant mieux aux dommages.
golem.material.text.void: Le golem est fait de métal du vide. Légèrement plus fragile que le fer, cet incovénient est compensé par un poids réduit et une capacité d'auto réparation.
golem.material.text.wood: Le golem est fait de Noble-bois. Il est léger et agile, mais pas particulièrement solide.
golem.prop.exist: Le conteneur doit déjà posseder des objets
golem.prop.lock: Seulement les golems appartenant au propriétaire du sceau peuvent effectuer ces tâches
golem.prop.provision.wl: Demande d'approvisionnement en provenance de la liste blanche
golem.prop.unlock: Tous les golems peuvent effectuer ces tâches
golem.trait.text.armored: Le golem est renforcé par des matériaux additionnels, augmentant son armure. Contre et est contré par Fragile.
golem.trait.text.blastproof: Le golem est très résistant aux explosions.
golem.trait.text.breaker: Le golem est capable de briser la plupart des blocs avec aise.
golem.trait.text.brutal: Le golem inflige d'avantage de dégâts au corps-à-corps.
golem.trait.text.climber: Les falaises à pic n'entravent pas le golem. Il peut les escalader pour atteindre son but avec aise.
golem.trait.text.clumsy: Le golem a très peu de dextérité manuelle et ne peut effectuer de tâches requérant plus que les interactions les plus basiques. Contre et est contré par Habile.
golem.trait.text.deft: Le golem a une grande dextérité manuelle et peut effectuer des tâches requérant précision et une manipulation délicate. Contre et est contré par Maladroit.
golem.trait.text.fighter: Le golem est capable de prendre des mesures hostiles contre d'autres entités.
golem.trait.text.fireproof: Le golem est immunisé au feu.
golem.trait.text.flyer: Le golem est capable de voler, augmentant sa mobilité au détriment de sa vitesse.
golem.trait.text.fragile: Le golem est fait de composants délicats et de matériaux fragiles, réduisant son montant de point de vie et son armure. Contre et est contré par Blindé.
golem.trait.text.hauler: Le golem peut transporter deux piles d'objets au lieu d'une seule.
golem.trait.text.heavy: Le golem est plus lourd que la moyenne, lui conférant une vitesse et une agilité réduite. Contre et est contré par Cadre Léger.
golem.trait.text.light: Le golem est plus léger que la moyenne, lui conférant une vitesse et une agilité accrue. Contre et est contré par Cadre Lourd.
golem.trait.text.ranged: Le golem peut attaquer des cibles à distance.
golem.trait.text.repair: Le golem répare les dommages subis à plus du double de la vitesse normale.
golem.trait.text.scout: La vue du golem porte très loin et son rayon d'opération est bien plus grand (48 blocs depuis sa position d'origine au lieu de 32).
golem.trait.text.smart: Le golem est presque conscient avec des capacités de raisonnement accrues ainsi que des capacités décisionnelles.
golem.trait.text.wheeled: Le golem se déplace sur roues. Cela lui confère une vitesse accrue, mais le rend incapable de sauter ou de se déplacer sur des pentes abruptes.
got.crystals: Vos doigts fourmillent étrangement lorsque vous avez le cristal en main. Qu'est-ce que cela veux dire ? Un peu de repos vous inspirera sûrement.
got.deepdown: You have visited deep and dark depths and have learned much.
got.dream: Vous vous réveiller d'un rêve étrange. Vous l'écrivez vite avant que votre mémoire ne s'estompe.

lore.arcaneresearch.alumentum:
Nitor gives light and warmth, but its flame is meek —
it will not smelt ore nor light a forge. Alumentum
sprang from another thought: take coal and breathe
into it as much fire-essence as it can hold, then add
a drop of entropy so that it may never know rest.
Thus is born a substance that does not simply burn —
it yearns to burn. Every piece pulses with restrained
fury, and the slightest blow sets it free. Alumentum
burns three times longer than common coal and hotter
than any flame, making it the true fuel of the
thaumaturge: in it, fire does not serve — it strains
for freedom. And those who hold it in their hands
must remember: instability is the price of power.
lore.arcaneresearch.crimson_cult_blade:
The Crimson Cult Blade is less a weapon than a ritual instrument: its edge was
forged and quenched in crimson fluid, and runes run along the metal that the cultists
read as a prayer rather than as writing. It does not rend flesh crudely — it seems
to draw out its warmth and memory, and every strike leaves a faint afterglow on
the blade, as though the edge remembered whom it had already served. In the hands
of a knight or praetor the blade behaves calmly, but in idleness it begins to
lean toward blood and hum softly, like a portal awaiting a sacrifice. It is never
left without work — otherwise it will remind its bearer that the Crimson Cult
feeds its gods not with prayers.
lore.arcaneresearch.crucible:
A Crucible is an iron cauldron in which water never remains merely water. Heated
by fire and steeped in Vis, it becomes a solvent that takes a thing apart into
its essence: metal yields its hardness, grass its scent and life, crystal its
light and cold — and all of it settles in the cauldron not as a potion but as
a memory of what the world was assembled from. The thaumaturge only prompts the
water to recall just what is needed; and when the brew murmurs contentedly, there
rises from it a thing that never was before, yet seems to have been waiting all
along to be gathered out of another's essence. The iron crucible will not abide
haste or dirty water, for alchemy forgives much — but not carelessness.
lore.arcaneresearch.dioptra:
The Thaumic Dioptra is a glass eye in a frame of arcane stone, tuned not to roads
or nodes but to the wounds of the world. When Vis gathers beyond measure and begins
to eat into the fabric of reality, malicious rifts show themselves within it —
fine cracks through which corruption and alien whispers seep. The dioptra patiently
leads the thaumaturge's gaze along these seams, glowing warmly where the world
has rotted clean through. It does not heal them; it only shows exactly where reality
is in need of defence, before a tear becomes a door.
lore.arcaneresearch.elemental_axe:
A common thaumium axe is merely sturdy and receptive
to enchantment, but saturated with the primal essence
of water it gains the will of the flow. The Axe of Flow
does not fell a tree piece by piece — it feels the whole
of the wood and brings it down in a single motion,
while the felled logs drift to their master as a river
bears its tribute. Even idle objects lying nearby
are swept up by its current.
lore.arcaneresearch.elemental_hoe:
A common thaumium hoe is merely sturdy and receptive
to enchantment, but saturated with the primal essences
of order and entropy it weaves growth. The Hoe of
Cultivation does not till soil by the span — it turns
a whole patch at once, and with a touch upon crops
and plants it hastens their growth, as if death
and life itself contended over the seedlings.
lore.arcaneresearch.elemental_pick:
A common thaumium pick is merely sturdy and receptive
to enchantment, but saturated with the primal essence
of fire it holds the heat of the forge. The Pick of
Essence does not merely crush stone — it tears the
purest native clusters from the ore, which smelt down
to twice the metal, as if the fire had already labored
over them. Its strike rings out with a sound that finds
precious ores in the depths.
lore.arcaneresearch.elemental_shovel:
A common thaumium shovel is merely sturdy and receptive
to enchantment, but saturated with the primal essence
of earth it moves strata. The Earthmover's Shovel does
not dig block by block — it lifts the land in whole
layers, and with a reverse motion can raise a matching
layer from stowed blocks. Its work obeys the will
of its master.
lore.arcaneresearch.elemental_sword:
A common thaumium sword is merely sturdy and receptive
to enchantment, but saturated with the primal essence
of air it cleaves the air in arcs. The Sword of the
West Winds leaves foes nearby no quarter: every strike
unleashes an arc of wind that wounds all who stand
beside the target. Raised toward a block, it wraps
its bearer in a whirlwind that repels enemies and
objects, deflects incoming projectiles, and slowly
lifts the bearer into the air.
lore.arcaneresearch.goggles:
Ordinary glass will show nothing, but these lenses,
cut to special designs, strip the veil from the world.
In them one sees what is hidden from the plain gaze:
nodes of aura, swirls of Flux, ghostly threads of Vis
running through all that is. The goggles grant no
power — they grant sight, and in thaumaturgy sight
is worth more than any spell. Wearing them, the
thaumaturge ceases to stumble in the dark and begins
to see the world as it truly is.
lore.arcaneresearch.nitor:
Nitor is not a torch, nor glowstone, but the very idea
of eternal flame, caught by alchemy. In the crucible,
where the essences of fire, light and order seethe,
glowstone dust sheds its coarse nature and is born
anew — as fire cleansed of heat and destruction.
Nitor burns without fuel and does not go out in the
rain, for there is nothing in it that could burn.
It floats where it was left, as if unwilling to touch
the ground, and pours forth a gentle light in which
darkness has no place. The thaumaturges of old called
it "a candle lit not by hands, but by matter itself" —
and gazing upon its steady flame, one understands:
this is not fire, this is light become essence.
lore.arcaneresearch.portal_scroll:
A Portal Scroll is a runic record of one particular point in the world, set down
in Vis-ink: within it are woven a cast of the aura, the breath of the nearest
nodes, the echo of stone and light. When the scroll is unfurled, the runes compel
space to admit, for a brief moment, that two places are touching — an even rift
opens in the air with the chosen goal visible beyond it, as though through a thickness
of glass. The passage does not last, and it dislikes haste, for it does not tear
the world but draws its fabric apart along the written lines. An error in the
runes leaves the seam open longer than it should, letting Flux seep out and foreign
whispers draw near — so the scroll is rolled up the moment the last traveller
has stepped through.
lore.arcaneresearch.runic_ring:
A band of metal inscribed with runes of protection, each holding a thin layer
of Vis woven into an unseen shield. When a blow falls on the thaumaturge, the
runes take it upon themselves, flashing orange and dimming, then slowly drawing
in the surrounding aura to gather the shield anew out of nothing. The ring does
not make its wearer invulnerable — it only grants them time, and so its runes
never sleep, humming quietly at the finger like a string stretched between the
world and whatever seeks to break into it.
lore.arcaneresearch.salis_mundus:
A shimmering alchemical dust, the spark of thaumaturgy,
gathered from crystals overflowing with energy.
Sprinkled upon a mundane block, it reshapes its
magical nature, allowing the crafting of items infused
with the mysterious energy of Vis.
lore.arcaneresearch.thaumometer:
A simple lens and a gilded rim — yet hold the
Thaumometer to an object and what is hidden from the
eye shines through: the weave of essences, the breath
of the aura, the unseen currents of Vis. It does not
merely measure — it teaches one to see. Every scan
leaves a grain of knowledge in the thaumaturge's
memory, from which theories later grow. Without it
the world stays mute; with it, it speaks the language
of aspects.
lore.arcaneresearch.thaumonomicon:
A book born of a strange dream. At first it is blank,
but every new experience, every revelation and every
theory writes its own pages. The Thaumonomicon does not
merely store knowledge — it guides the thaumaturge,
unfolding the research they are already ready for
and concealing what they are not. It is a diary,
a teacher, and a map of the road into the unknown.
But the deeper one looks into it, the more often
it looks back.
lore.arcaneresearch.traveller_boots:
Boots with the energy of Vis woven into them: when a thaumaturge steps into them,
the earth underfoot seems to lay down a path of its own, and the weariness of
a long road gives way to a stubborn wish to keep walking. But the boots will not
abide idleness — left standing still, they begin to creak quietly, as if reminding
their bearer that the road is waiting.

research.ADVANCEDTURRET.stage.1: My recent discovery of advanced artificial minds might allow me to make some much needed improvements to my automated turrets.
research.ADVANCEDTURRET.stage.2:
The advanced automated crossbow works much like its basic counterpart, with a few significant improvements.
the addition of iron plating makes it much sturdier, and a more complicated loading mechanism gives it a greater rate of fire.
lastly, it is possible to specify the type of targets it can attack.
research.ADVANCEDTURRET.title: Advanced automated crossbow
research.ALUMENTUM.stage.1:
Nitor is a useful substance. it provides heat, light and is aesthetically pleasing. unfortunately it provides only slightly more heat than a torch - enough to slowly heat some water or keep you warm at night, but not enough for practical purposes like smelting ore.
i need something more... reactive.
i should take some time to collect my thoughts and study the elements. maybe there is a way to improve coal like i did glowstone.
research.ALUMENTUM.stage.2:
I was right! i should be able to take a lump of coal and add more of the essentia it already contains... and possibly a little bit of perditio for extra kick.
if my calculations are correct the resulting substance, which i have called alumentum, should burn three times longer than normal coal.
my calculations also show that the substance will be quite energetic and i should take care not to chuck it about... not unless i have good reason to, that is.
research.ALUMENTUM.title: Alumentum
research.ARCANEBORE.stage.1:
I need to work out an automated way of digging out large areas. it should be a fairly simple matter to redesign one of my new turrets to target the ground instead of enemies.
my discovery of the breaker focus effect should allow me to create a specialized and limited version of a caster that can be used by this mining turret.
research.ARCANEBORE.stage.2:
I have designed a mining device i am calling the arcane bore. once placed and given a redstone signal it will start digging out an area in front of it. the device requires a pickaxe to be placed inside it. normally inanimate objects cannot use foci, but with a liberal application of sympathetic magic the focus could be 'tricked' into working.
this had a unforeseen benefit as well - the pickaxe is actually being used to dig on metaphysical level and any attributes and enchantments it has are actually applied to the digging process. the pickaxe will wear out however, but much slower than normal - i estimate an average pickaxe will last about 50 times longer.
the size of the area dug is also determined by the material of the pickaxe. the more enchantable the material is, the more efficient the sympathetic magic is, which in turn increases the area that can be dug.
any blocks dug are ejected at the position of the bore. if there is an inventory adjacent to the bore the items will be placed in there instead.the bore also requires vis to function consuming 1 vis for every 4 blocks dug.the bore can be turned to face any direction except down. to change the direction it faces simply left-click on it to make it face towards you.
like other arcane turrets the bore will also respond to arcane activator rails - passing over an inactive rail will switch it on while an active one will disable it.
research.ARCANEBORE.title: Arcane bore
research.ARCANEEAR.stage.1: I should investigate the creation of arcane sensors that can react to things in the world. maybe sound is a good place to start.
research.ARCANEEAR.stage.2:
I have succeeded! the arcane ear is a device that is capable of detecting the sound emitted from nearby note blocks. if it hears a note it recognises, it will emit a short redstone pulse.
the arcane ear needs to be tuned in a manner identical to note blocks, the tone and note it listens for depends on the material it is placed against.
arcane ears can be placed against any surface.i can also craft a version of the arcane ear that toggles on or off when it hears a note instead of sending a pulse.
research.ARCANEEAR.title: Arcane ear
research.ARCANELAMP.stage.1: My laboratory has seemed quite gloomy of late. i should find a way to light it more effectively.
research.ARCANELAMP.stage.2:
This mystical lamp can be attached to walls, floors or ceilings and will provide strong and steady light.
additional sources of light may also appear up to 16 blocks away wherever light levels fall below accepted 'safe' levels. remember: only you can prevent zombie outbreaks.
these secondary sources of light will disappear soon after the lamp has been removed.
the lamp can be turned off by applying a redstone signal.
research.ARCANELAMP.title: Arcane lamp
research.ARCANEPATTERNCRAFTER.stage.1: Certain objects are very simple to craft - simply place the same type of item in a pattern and you get what you want. for example combining 2 wood planks to make a stick, or a single ingot making 9 nuggets. this process is so simple that i am sure there is a way to automate it. i have some theories i need to try.
research.ARCANEPATTERNCRAFTER.stage.2:
I have designed a device i am calling the arcane pattern crafter. the arcane pattern crafter needs an inventory above and below it. it will search the inventory above it for components and try to combine whatever it finds in the pattern you have selected. if this results in a valid crafting operation it will place the result in the container below it.
you can change the pattern by clicking on the brass dial on the front of the device.
a redstone signal will disable the device.each crafting operation will drain 1 vis from the aura.
research.ARCANEPATTERNCRAFTER.title: Arcane pattern crafter
research.ARCANESPA.stage.1: Pouring bath salts into water is a bit of a chore, but luckily one easily solved with a bit of magic and ingenuity.
research.ARCANESPA.stage.2:
I have created a handy machine that when filled with water and bath salts, will automatically mix them and pump the liquid into an area above it. the liquid will fill a 5x5 area above the location where the machine is placed.
additionally, i have designed it in such a way that it can be used to pump nearly any liquid i can fill it with. it can be filled with automation, or by clicking on the block with the appropriate container. applying a redstone signal will disable it.
research.ARCANESPA.title: Arcane spa
research.ARMORFORTRESS.stage.1: Thaumium armor has many things to recommend it, but its basic construction leaves it inferior to diamond armor. i should find a way to improve the construction process and complexity.
research.ARMORFORTRESS.stage.2:
I set out to improve thaumium armor and i think i have outdone myself. i have drawn up designs for a suit of armor of exceptional craftsmanship, durability and strength. i am calling it thaumium fortress armor.
each individual piece of thaumium fortress armor has the same protective properties as diamond armor, but has greater durability and offers additional protection against magic and fire.
the biggest benefit however is that the individual armor pieces are designed and constructed to be worn together: each additional piece of this armor worn increases the overall protection offered by all other pieces and improves its visual appeal.
as with most objects constructed from thaumium, the armor is easy to enchant.
research.ARMORFORTRESS.title: Thaumium fortress armor
research.BASEALCHEMY.stage.1:
Crucible crafting guide
1) place crucible over heat source (fire, lava, nitor or something similar).
2) add water and wait till it boils.
3) add ingredients with the essentia you require, either by dropping them in or clicking with the item on the crucible's top face
4) throw in catalyst.things to note
- shift-right clicking with an empty hand will empty a crucible.
- each crafting operation will consume some of the water so i will have to replenish it now and again. piping mechanics can be used for this.
- i can craft multiple items at once by adding sufficient essentia and using multiple catalysts.
- essentia does dissolve over time so i shouldn't wait too long before starting to craft. i wonder what the purple puffs of smoke means when this happens? probably nothing to worry about.§ocrafting crystals§r
essentia crystals should be fairly easy to craft. all i need to do is break down a quartz crystal into smaller shards to act as a growth medium.
simply dipping a shard into the crucible should soak up some of the essentia it contains and cause the crystal to grow.
this won't be a particularly efficient way of doing things - it will probably cost at least twice the essentia that the crystal will end up containing and there is the net loss of quartz which is not always the easiest thing to find.
research.BASEALCHEMY.title: Basic alchemy
research.BASEARTIFICE.stage.1: I am now ready to begin crafting magical mechanisms and intricate arcane devices.
research.BASEARTIFICE.title: Basic artifice
research.BASEAUROMANCY.stage.1:
I have the casting glove, but now i need to craft the foci. the old scrolls aren't very clear on how to go about this, so i will need to find my own way.
i have played with the idea of assembling a focus from crystals and then using vis to bind them together. my initial experiments have been failures... explosive failures.
i think the answer i seek lies with an alchemical process.
using an ordo crystal as a core i might be able to leverage its ordered structure to grow a focus around it. while this is happening it should absorb praecantatio and auram essentia.
the result should hopefully be a crystal focus able to absorb and manipulate vis.
research.BASEAUROMANCY.stage.2:
Using alchemy to create the focus was indeed the path to success. the focus is stable and clear - now i simply need to imprint the proper patterns into it. for this i will need a focal manipulator
i have already drawn up plans for a focal manipulator. the way it functions is similar to an arcane workbench in many ways, but instead of using vis to craft items it instead imprints patterns into the focus crystal.
i must also design the patterns that i will need to imprint. i have an idea for a pattern to create flame, but i need to do some more research.
research.BASEAUROMANCY.stage.3:
I have everything i need. all i need to do is craft my first focus.
by arranging specially prepared vis crystals around the blank focus i can set up patterns that will determine what function the focus will perform. for now i only know the patterns for §nroot§0, §ntouch§0 and §nfire§0.
the §nroot§0 node represents me, the caster. in the focal manipulator interface it is shown as an eye icon. the empty node below it is marked with both a target and a trajectory icon. mediums (like §ntouch§0) require trajectories to determine what they effect - the §nroot§0 node provides a trajectory that matches where the caster is looking so by linking §ntouch§0 to it i will be able to 'touch' anything i am looking at. mediums almost always provide a target (in this case whatever has been 'touched') and some can also provide a trajectory. in this case though i require a target so i will be able to link the §nfire§0 effect.
by linking §nroot§0, §ntouch§0 and §nfire§0 in this way i will be able to create a focus that applies the §nfire§0 effect to whatever i touch.
i could in theory link §nfire§0 directly to §nroot§0, but since root provides the caster as a target that means i will simply set myself on fire.
i can fine tune exactly what the §nfire§0 effect does by tweaking its damage and burn duration in the bottom right of the interface. many patterns will allow me to fine tune them in this way.
creating a focus require three types of resources - the first is the crystals used in the crafting process, the second is vis from the aura, and lastly it also requires some player experience. every time a focus is used it will also consume a small amount of vis from the aura.§ncomplexity§0
the effects i can create now are fairly simple and limited. there is a limit to how many patterns i can attach to a focus. this is measured as the focus complexity. each pattern type has a complexity cost and increasing their paramaters (for example the damage of a fire pattern) will increase the complexity further. using a pattern more than once also incurs a stacking complexity cost increase of 50%.
the complexity of a focus directly determines how much vis it will cost to cast and how long the caster gauntlet needs to cooldown between casts.
research.BASEAUROMANCY.title: Basic auromancy
research.BASEELDRITCH.stage.1:
The void seed i have discovered begs further study. i should study it further and perhaps discover a practical use for it.
currently it seems morphicly unstable - it's physical properties are constantly shifting and changing shape. maybe binding it with something else will make it easier to manipulate. metal perhaps?
research.BASEELDRITCH.stage.2:
My hand shakes as i write this. the strange substance i have investigated has opened strange new vistas in my mind.
before me i have formulas for creating a mysterious new metal, yet i do not remember writing them, nor does the handwriting look quite like mine.
the metal they describe is a mass of contradictions. it is hard and unyielding, yet at the same time soft and easy to work. it will feel warm to the touch, almost alive and like living things it will slowly heal itself if damaged.
crafting mere physical tools from this seems almost... wrong.
research.BASEELDRITCH.title: Void seeds
research.BASEGOLEMANCY.stage.1: I now understand the basic concepts that shape golemancy, but i am sure i can improve on the primitive constructs that anyone can craft. at the very least i can use arcane science to design a simple mind that will be both dependable and predictable instead of relying on the chaotic nature of magic to direct my constructs.
research.BASEGOLEMANCY.title: Basic golemancy
research.BASEINFUSION.stage.1: I am now ready to begin crafting enchanted objects and tools.<line>i have drawn up designs for some banners to decorate my lab. i can apply a phial of essentia to them to have them display that essentia symbol.
research.BASEINFUSION.title: Basic infusion
research.BASICTURRET.stage.1: A few attacks from wandering monsters has recently turned my mind towards home defense. i should design some sort of automated device that will defend my home from unwanted intruders.
research.BASICTURRET.stage.2:
I have found a way to give a crossbow a mind of its own, turning it into a simple automated turret.
when placed in the world it will automatically fire at any hostile monsters it detects within range. unfortunately its limited mind does not allow me to fine tune its targets.
it has a very limited internal inventory, but if i place it over an upward facing dispenser it will automatically reload itself from that inventory.
right clicking on it while sneaking will pick it up.the turret can ride in a minecart and will reload from a dispenser placed underneath the track.
passing over an arcane activator rail will change the behaviour of the turret. if the rail is active it will disable the turret. passing over an inactive rail will enable it again.
research.BASICTURRET.title: Automated crossbow
research.BATHSALTS.stage.1:
Warp is a danger for even the most careful of thaumaturges. for those that have done a bit too much dabbling, warp effects are probably more than just an annoyance.
i should make solving this problem a priority. even if i am not able to remove warp, at the very least i should be able to alleviate it's effects.
research.BATHSALTS.stage.2:
I have drawn up a recipe to create relaxing and refreshing bath salts. simply tossing these salts into water will turn the water into a silvery, purifying liquid that soothes away the stresses of the day and brings temporary relief from the effects of warp. i should note however that the more warp a thaumaturge suffers from, the shorter the duration of this protection.
the salts are quite fragile and will soon dissolve if tossed around haphazardly.
research.BATHSALTS.title: Purifying bath salts
research.BELLOWS.stage.1:
I should start with some simple projects to test my theories. animating the inanimate is no simple feat.
stoking furnaces with a bellows increases their heat and smelting speed, but pumping air by hand seems like a crazy waste of my time and talent. now, if the bellows were able to pump itself that would be a different matter entirely.
research.BELLOWS.stage.2:
The arcane bellows performs much the same function as its mundane counterpart, the only difference is that it happily pumps away by itself sending forth a stream of never-ending air.
as i had hoped they can be attached to furnances to increase their smelting speed.
it is also possible to attach them to crucibles to reduce the time it takes for their water to boil.
bellows can be deactivated by applying a redstone signal.
i am confident more uses will reveal themselves eventually.
research.BELLOWS.title: Arcane bellows
research.BOOTSTRAVELLER.stage.1: I need to create something that will ease my travels. i should examine the mechanics of movement and how one can go about improving it.
research.BOOTSTRAVELLER.stage.2:
I have designed a pair of enchanted boots that will ease the journey of any traveler.
they will allow one to move faster, jump higher and fall further.
lastly they allow you to cut through water like a fish. a slow and clumsy fish, but a fish nonetheless.
this power does have a cost however - the boots need to be charged with vis for their abilities to function.
research.BOOTSTRAVELLER.title: Boots of the traveler
research.BOTTLETAINT.stage.1:
I should be able to replicate the taint causing properties of flux. i am not exactly sure why i would want to, but sometimes progress requires risk.
the process should be fairly simple - i merely need to create a concentrated mixture of flux and it should easily react with almost anything to create taint.
research.BOTTLETAINT.title: Bottled taint
research.BrainyZombie.stage.1:
I have observed that some zombies seem much more aware than their lumbering brethren. their eyes burn with a malevolent intelligence leading me to believe that they retained much more intelligence after death than is normal. they are definitely more aggressive and dangerous than a normal zombie.
they should make good sources of brain matter for my experiments.
research.CELESTIALSCANNING.stage.1:
I have noticed a link between the phases of the moon and the speed at which the aura replenishes itself. i should investigate this phenomenon further and even expand my investigation to see if other heavenly bodies influence magic.
a few minor tweaks to my thaumometer should enable it to take measurements from objects in the sky. i should remember to carry some paper and scribing tools with me so i can take notes.
measuring the same body or quadrant of the sky more than once a day will not give me new insights - i need to study them over time to measure changes in their aural influence.
the notes i gather should come in handy for theorycrafting.
research.CELESTIALSCANNING.title: Celestial observation
research.CENTRIFUGE.stage.1: I often find myself with complex essentia i have no real need for. i need to find a way to put all that unused essentia to a practical use.
research.CENTRIFUGE.stage.2:
The alchemical centrifuge is a wondrous invention that allows me to break essentia into its component parts.
when compound essentia flows into the centrifuge from below it will be slowly broken down into the primal or compound essentia that it is made from. only one of the components is created for each point of essentia broken down.
the resulting essentia needs to be drawn from the top of the centrifuge. because of the idiosyncrasies of the tube pressure system, it would be best to connect an essentia buffer to the top of the centrifuge.
research.CENTRIFUGE.title: Essentia centrifuge
research.CHARMUNDYING.stage.1:
The totem of undying is potent magic that even thaumaturgy cannot easily replicate.
i should however be able to make the totem more convenient to use by allowing it to be worn as a charm instead of having to be held.
research.CHARMUNDYING.title: Charm of undying
research.CLOUDRING.stage.1:
I should get my feet wet by creating a simple bauble. after some thought i decided to create a ring that will reduce falling damage and possibly help my mobility.
it should be fairly simple to draw up plans for something like that.
research.CLOUDRING.stage.2: I have made plans for a bauble i am calling the cloudstepper ring. it makes the wearer lighter, therefore greatly reducing falling damage. additionally it can create a momentary puff of air below the wearer when they jump, allowing them to perform a second jump in mid-air.
research.CLOUDRING.title: Cloudstepper ring
research.CONTROLSEALS.stage.1:
Golems cannot do anything they are not told to do. for this purpose i have created control seals. you can place these circular clay seals against almost any surface you wish. once you do they will become become ethereal and intangible, but you will still be able to see them as long as you hold a golem, another seal or §5golemancer's bell§0.
the bell will be an important tool as you will use it to fine tune the settings and parameters of the command seals.
since seals are ethereal you can place down another block in the same spot as you placed a seal.
several seals can also occupy the same block space as long as the are located on different faces of a block. this should allow you to keep things quite compact.
you can retrieve a seal by holding shift and right-clicking on it with the bell.clicking on a seal with the bell will allow you to tweak its parameters. the exact parameters will vary from seal to seal, but most seals will allow you to give them a priority between -5 and +5 (default 0). tasks created by higher priority seals will be performed first. you will also be able to see a list of required traits that a golem will need to have in order to perform tasks created by that seal.
for example, a seal might require a golem to have the §5deft§0 trait, or perhaps another seal will require that a golem not have the §5clumsy§0 trait.
for a practical example, look at the §5collect seal§0.seals can be set to become inactive when they recieve a redstone signal. all queued or in progress tasks from that seal will also be removed.
it is also possible to assign a color to a seal. if you do so tasks from that seal will only be performed by uncolored golems or golems with the same color. uncolored seals will assign tasks to all golems (colored and uncolored alike).
you set seal colors in the same location where you set priorities.
you assign a golem a color by using a dye on it. the color will be cleared if the golem is picked up.
research.CONTROLSEALS.title: Control seals
research.CRIMSONAMULET.stage.1: The cultist fell, and a small amulet slipped from his robes — heavy, warm to the touch, with a scratched rune I could not read at first glance. This is no ornament: it holds the trace of crimson magic and quietly draws the aura toward itself. Before I touch it again, I must understand what it really is.
research.CRIMSONAMULET.stage.2: Under the lens the rune resolved into a prayer. The amulet grants no power — it marks its bearer, and by it the cultists recognise one another. Four such amulets, fused with visnerite in an Infusion Matrix, could become the core of a blade that draws warmth and memory out of an enemy.
research.CRIMSONAMULET.title: Crimson Cult Amulet
research.CRIMSONBLADE.stage.1: I held a blade quenched in crimson fluid and understood: it is less a weapon than a rite. The runes along the metal are read as a prayer rather than as writing, and every strike leaves an afterglow on the edge, as though it remembered whom it had already served. To forge another I will need the cult's amulets, visnerite ingots, and essentia of darkness, life and metal.
research.CRIMSONBLADE.stage.2: In the Infusion Matrix the blade finds its true nature: it draws warmth and memory from the enemy, visits weakness and hunger upon them, and returns a portion of the damage to me. In the hands of a knight or praetor it behaves calmly, but in idleness it begins to hum like a portal awaiting a sacrifice. I never leave it without work — the Crimson Cult feeds its gods not with prayers.
research.CRIMSONBLADE.title: Blade of the Crimson Cult
research.CRYSTALFARMER.stage.1: I have observed that vis crystals naturally grow over time, but once i harvest them they seem to lose this ability. i am hoping to discover what exactly is lost and how to reinvigorate the crystals.
research.CRYSTALFARMER.stage.2:
I have found a way to reinvigorate vis crystals in such a way that i can replant them.
i am hoping this means i can grow my own steady supply of primal vis crystals.
research.CRYSTALFARMER.title: Crystal farming
research.CURIOSITYBAND.stage.1: The experience orbs i gather from harvested resources and slain monsters contain both magical energy and packets of knowledge. i am certain that more can be done with them than simple enchanting.
research.CURIOSITYBAND.stage.2:
My theory has proven correct - i have found a way to extract fragments of knowledge from experience orbs. these parcels of knowledge are very small but may provide useful snippets of insight into certain kinds of research.
i have drawn up designs for a headband that when worn will absorb half the experience from any orbs i collect and turn it into research knowledge. the rate of return is very low, but every little bit helps.
research.CURIOSITYBAND.title: Headband of curiosity
research.CrimsonCultist.stage.1:
These red-robed cultists have been popping up of late. their goals are unknown to me and they seem unwilling to talk. beyond that there is something... wrong about them. their grip on sanity seems tenuous at best, but the wrongness goes much deeper than that. it is hard to describe.
my presence seems to enrage them and i believe it might have something to do with my capacity for thaumaturgy.
their clerics are also capable of wielding magic and i can sense that they are drawing it from the aura, but the magic itself does not seem to be thaumaturgy. whatever it is, it makes my skin crawl and i can feel the aura buckling and tearing every time they draw upon it.
some of them seem to carry a book around. i should try and get my hand on one of those, maybe it will tell me more about this strange cult. i should be careful though, some knowledge can be dangerous.
research.CrimsonCultist.title: The crimson cult
research.CrimsonRites.stage.1: I should find the book the cultists call the crimson rites and study it.
research.CrimsonRites.stage.2:
Much of this book is written in a spidery and unintelligible script, but what i can understand offers me some strange insights into the goals of the crimson cult.
their origins are shrouded in mystery, but it seems their goal is the perfection of a ritual they refer to as "apertis oculis" - opening the eye. what it does is unclear, but i doubt it is anything good.
interestingly enough, i think thaumaturgy might offer the missing pieces they have so long sought. obviously only a madman would pursue this line of study...
research.CrimsonRites.title: The crimson rites
research.DECONSTRUCTOR.stage.1:
There comes a point in any thaumaturge's career where progress stalls for lack of knowledge.
One possible recourse is the Deconstruction Table. It allows you to break down objects into their simplest parts which you can then examine. There are limits however - the table breaks compound aspects into their component aspects until only primal aspects remain. Much knowledge is lost in the process, and the best the thaumaturge can hope for is a single piece of primal knowledge.
For example an iron ingot (Metallum) will be simplified into Terra and Ordo, only one of which will have a chance of being discovered.
It is also a fairly slow process: the fewer aspects an object has, the lower the chance to discover something.
research.DECONSTRUCTOR.title: Deconstruction Table
research.DIOPTRA.stage.1: While a thaumometer will show me the local aura it would be useful to be able to get a general overview of the aura in a larger area. a device like this should be simple enough to design and make.
research.DIOPTRA.stage.2:
As i expected it was not hard to expand on the workings of the thaumometer to design the thaumic dioptra.
this device allows a thaumaturge to see the surrounding aura in a simple and clear manner. it will render the aura in a 13 chunk diameter area around it as a simple height map. it can also be switched to show flux instead by simply clicking on it.
a comparator can be connected if you want to monitor the aura or flux level of the chunk in which it is placed.
research.DIOPTRA.title: Thaumic dioptra
research.DISCOVERIES.stage.1:
A theory unwritten is a theory lost. If my discoveries are to outlive my memory, I need proper workplaces: a sturdy worktable of my own, scribing tools, paper — and my thaumometer.
I need TWO tables now. Place two plain tables side by side and click them with scribing tools: they grow into a table of Cognition, with room for paper and aspect-bearing items. Its work is Knowledge: fill a research note to 100%.
Place another two tables side by side and click them with my thaumometer: they grow into a table of Study. It takes notes and scribing tools, and its weaving of connections runs on my aspect pool — aspects I gather by studying the world, or by combining them. Victory there is Study.
research.DISCOVERIES.stage.2:
When both works are done — Knowledge at 100% and Study won — the note becomes a discovery right in the Cognition table. Presenting it by hand completes the research.
Such discoveries are the keys that unlock the harder pages of my work: no discovery, no progress.
research.DISCOVERIES.title: Discoveries
research.ELDRITCHMAJOR.stage.1:
Un voile à été levé - une porte s'est ouverte dans mon esprit.
Quand je regarde à traves je vois des merveilles. Non, pas des merveilles. §mCe que je vois est§r
§oCe que je vois est JE vois je vois JE voIs j§rarcaneresearch:textures/misc/eldritchajor1.png:0:0:256:256:0.5
research.ELDRITCHMAJOR.title: Révolution Surnaturelle
research.ELDRITCHMINOR.stage.1:
C'est soudainement devenu clair pour vous. Là où d'autres ne voient que chaos, vous apercevez occasionnellement une portion d'un motif... un très étrange et dérangent motif. Quelque chose remue dans les coins les plus sombres de l'univers.
Vous avez essayé de l'expliquer aux autres, mais avez seulement reçu des regards étrange en retour. Peu importe, vous leur montrerez un jour.
Vous leur montrerez à tous!
research.ELDRITCHMINOR.title: Epiphanie surnaturelle
research.ELEMENTALTOOLS.stage.1:
With the discovery of infusion, i should experiment with binding primal elements into tools and weapons. if i am correct this will grant them unique and powerful properties.
for my initial experiments i should stick to working with thaumium tools - they will be easy to infuse and will be a good base for future experiments.
research.ELEMENTALTOOLS.stage.2:
I have drawn up the required rites to infuse the thaumium tools i have created. if my calculations are correct they will have some unique and interesting abilities.§oaxe of the stream§r
by combining water shards and a thaumium axe, i have designed a tool that embodies the aspects of motion and flow.
it functions like a normal axe on all materials except natural logs and trees. when used on them the axe seeks to furthest block of the same type that is still connected to the block you are attempting to harvest and harvests that one instead.
in effect you will chop trees from the top down even if you hit the bottom-most block.
any wood chopped in this fashion will automatically float towards you.
if you press and hold right click the axe will axe will draw all nearby items towards you - not just wood it chopped.
if shift is held while using this tool all its special properties are suspended and it functions like a normal axe.§opickaxe of the core§r
by infusing a thaumium pickaxe with fire shards, i have designed a pickaxe that glows with the heat of a forge.
when you mine ore blocks there is a chance that you will mine a cluster instead. native clusters are much easier to process and produces double the normal amount of metal when smelted.
it can also be used to sound out any surface you right click against to find out what valuable ores can be found nearby.
if shift is held while using this tool all its special properties are suspended and it functions like a normal pickaxe.§osword of the zephyr§r
i have merged the elemental fury of air shards with a thaumium sword.
when used to strike a foe, the blade will sweep in a wide arc, hitting additional foes near your main target.
while blocking the sword will conjure a sphere of whirling winds around you, pushing enemies and loose objects away and deflecting incoming projectiles.
while blocking it will also slowly lift you into the air.§oshovel of the earthmover§r
combining earth shards with a thaumium shovel i have designed a peerless digging implement.
when used to dig earth, sand and similar materials it will dig a 3x3 area.
if you right click on the side of a block, it will attempt to place a 3x3 section of the same material in the world as long as you have sufficient blocks in my inventory.
the orientation of both the digging and construction depends on the face you dug or clicked.
if shift is pressed you can see where blocks will be placed in the world and you can change the orientation of how blocks are placed by pressing 'g' on the keyboard. blocks can be placed either parallel to the block face selected, or extending out of the face vertically or horizontally.
if shift is held while using this tool it will no longer dig in a 3x3 pattern.§ohoe of growth§r
by merging the magical energy from order and entropy shards with a thaumium hoe, i have created a farming implement with few equals.
when used to till fields, it will till a 3x3 area instead of just a single block.
when used to crops or other plants it will act as bonemeal to promote its growth, though at a higher cost to its durability. it might even be able to grow plants that normal bonemeal can't.
if shift is held while using this tool all its special properties are suspended and it functions like a normal hoe.
research.ELEMENTALTOOLS.title: Elemental tools
research.ENTEROUTER.stage.1:
I stepped through — and found a place with no light and no familiar sky: a labyrinth of eldritch stone running in every direction, its walls keeping the traces of those who wandered here before me. The air is thick with foreign aura, and in it I hear footsteps that are not mine.
Something ancient tends these halls, and I must be careful. Yet the longer I walk, the clearer it becomes: the knowledge waiting here is worth the risk, and I am no longer the one who merely stood before the portal — I am the one who knows what lies behind it.
research.ENTEROUTER.title: Outer Lands
research.ESSENTIASMELTER.bellows: Bellows placed on the side of a smelter will greatly increase the heat it generates, allowing items to be broken down into a slurry much quicker.
research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.1:
I see a time fast approaching where i will need to have ready access to multiple different kinds of essentia. for that i will need a source and the most obvious is the essentia found in, well, everything.
using alchemical principles, i should be able to find a way to break down objects and convert them into essentia. before i can start however i will need to study essentia in the purest form available to me - vis crystals.
by subjecting these crystals to, um, "destructive testing" i should be able to determine how they react in various extremes and the best way to preserve their purity.
i should start with primal essentia.
research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.2:
My experiments are promising, if a bit unpredictable. fortunately the fires were easily quenched and my hair should grow back in a few days.
it seems melting objects down in a special alchemical process is my best option. unfortunately my tests so far have been on primal crystals. i should also test my finding on crystals containing secondary essentia - that is essentia made up of a combination of two primal aspects.
a third tier known as tertiary essentia also exists. that is essentia made up of a mixture of primal and secondary aspects, or two secondary aspects.
research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.3:
I have managed to break down all my samples of primary and secondary essentia into a liquid state. the process has been slow and tedious however. until i simplify the process it will never be practical for large scale usage.
luckily extracting essentia from objects has a lot in common with the smelting of metals. using a furnace as a base i might be able to create an essentia smeltery that automatically melts down items and separates out individual types of essentia.
research.ESSENTIASMELTER.stage.4:
I have drawn up the plans for an essentia smelter. the smelter works much like a normal furnace by burning coal to produce heat, but instead of smelting ore into metal, it breaks down objects into a slurry of raw, unprocessed essentia. this process isn't very efficient and a small amount of essentia is converted into flux roughly 20% of the time.
the next step in the process is to take the essentia slurry and distill it using an arcane alembic.
to work, arcane alembics need to be placed on top of a smelter. multiple alembics can be placed on top of each other to increase storage, but it does not influence processing speed. the essentia slurry will slowly be drawn into the alembic and the individual aspected essentia separated out.
if the smelter is being powered by alumentum, this distillation process is much faster.
the essentia can then be extracted out of an alembic using phials, jars or more complex means.
research.ESSENTIASMELTER.title: Essentia smelting
research.ESSENTIASMELTERTHAUMIUM.stage.1:
The basic essentia smelter is quite crude, if i have to be honest with myself. it is extremely inefficient and rather slow. i chalk this up to the low quality of the materials it is crafted from.
i believe thaumium could prove useful in improving the smelting process. i should run some experiments to see how effective it would be at containing essentia slurry.
i should probably also improve the plumbing inside the smelter itself.
research.ESSENTIASMELTERTHAUMIUM.stage.2:
Thaumium has proven to be a good choice, though not quite as effective as i had hoped.
the thaumium smeltery works much like the basic smeltery, but it has roughly 90% efficiency instead of 80%. not nearly the improvement i was hoping for, but better than nothing i suppose.
its main benefit is that it breaks down essentia slurry at double the normal speed.
research.ESSENTIASMELTERTHAUMIUM.title: Thaumium essentia smelter
research.ESSENTIASMELTERVOID.stage.1:
I need to go back to the drawing board. using thaumium did improve the smelting process, but not to the degree i had hoped.
my recent discovery of void metal has opened up a new avenue of research for me. it is much more resilient and malleable than thaumium. i should put it through the same battery of tests i did for thaumium and see how the two compare.
it might also be worth changing the internal plumbing to incorporate void metal in some manner.
research.ESSENTIASMELTERVOID.stage.2:
I am pleased with the results of my testing. i expect the void metal smeltery will work much like the basic smeltery, but at roughly 95% efficiency instead of 80%.
it should break down essentia slurry slightly quicker than the basic smeltery, but not nearly as fast as the thaumium smeltery.
research.ESSENTIASMELTERVOID.title: Void metal essentia smelter
research.ESSENTIATRANSPORT.stage.1:
During the infusion crafting process essentia is drawn directly from jars and floats through the air to the infusion matrix. the magic of the matrix keeps it stable enough for the infusion process, but normally the essentia is changed in such a way that it becomes unusable for anything else.
if only i can find a way to draw essentia through the air outside of the infusion process and still keep it stable.
research.ESSENTIATRANSPORT.stage.2:
I have cracked the method of keeping aerated essentia stable outside of infusion.
i have drawn up plans for two devices. the filling essentia transfuser can take essentia directly from a pipe network or other essentia source and transport it to jars within 16 blocks of the direction it is facing.
the emptying essentia transfuser does the opposite - drawing essentia from jars within range and placing it within tubes or devices requiring essentia of a specific type.
research.ESSENTIATRANSPORT.title: Advanced essentia transport
research.EVERFULLURN.stage.1:
Alchemical creation has proven to be much easier than i expected. if i can somehow automate this process to create something simple and practical it will go a long way toward further alchemical breakthroughs.
maybe something like an infinite water source would be a good start?
research.EVERFULLURN.stage.2:
A small fountain of pure water always flows from the top of this urn, making it a perfect water source to fill my buckets, bottles or other liquid containers.
the urn will also automatically replenish any liquid containers within two blocks of it if they can accept water from the top. this is perfect for automatically refilling crucibles, but has other uses as well.
fluid pipes can be attached to the top of the urn for more mundane uses.
every bucket full of water created costs 1 vis which is drawn directly from the aura.
the water does taste a bit... odd. nothing to worry about i'm sure.
research.EVERFULLURN.title: Everfull urn
research.EldritchCrab.stage.1:
Eldritch crabs, or helmed crabs, are a most unusual and unnatural creature. i am convinced these creatures are the result of magical tinkering.
a pair of powerful claws make them dangerous to face in combat, but it is how they use those claws that make them horrific. they leap at their foes heads in an attempt to decapitate them. if successful they are somehow able to burrow into the victims body and take control of what remains. their abdomen looks much like a helmed head allowing them to disguise the true nature of the husk they now control.
these husks are not much more powerful than a normal zombie so the reason why they do this eludes me - they are much more of a threat without their 'mount'. possibly they were created as weapons of terror by some demented inventor?
research.EldritchGuardian.stage.1:
These ghost-like figures are a dangerous menace. they can be found wherever the walls of reality are at their thinnest. i believe they act as guardians of such places, protecting those weak spots from trespassers.
their form is held together by dimensional energies from some other place making them much weaker in our world. i would hate having to confront them in whatever place they call home.
their touch is deadly and they are able to hurl entropic dimensional energy at those too far to reach.
research.FIRSTSTEPS.stage.1:
Who would have thought that a few sprinkles of dust could have created this marvellous book? it is mostly blank, but it hints at a powerful new form of magic: thaumaturgy.
firstly i will need to study the magical world that has been shown to me. for that i will need a tool - a thaumometer the book calls it.
a normal crafting table won't do however since the magical energies i need to channel while crafting it are quite delicate. a sprinkling of salis mundus on a mundane crafting table should solve that. the book has taught me the proper incantation to use so it should be a simple matter.
to keep myself on track i will make a list of all the requirements that need to be met on the first page of each new entry.
research.FIRSTSTEPS.stage.2:
Progress! i now have an arcane workbench at my disposal. it works much like a mundane crafting table and can even be used as such, however there are a few key differences.
firstly, many arcane recipes will require the use of those vis crystals i've been finding of late. they act as a focus for the magical energy i need to channel into the items i craft. the book calls this magical energy vis.
supposedly this energy is all around me, but as yet i cannot perceive or measure it.
it is time i craft the thaumometer and use it to study the world around me. it should clearly mark those things i still need to examine.
i have placed a bookmark to the thaumometer recipe on the right.
research.FIRSTSTEPS.stage.3:
Such strange wonders are being revealed to me. peering through the lens of the thaumometer shows me a world coursing with magic, vis as the books calls it.
normally this energy is a pure ocean of magic that ebbs and flows, but it also permeates all things, both animate and inanimate. the book calls vis in this state essentia. where vis is formless and pure, essentia is more rigid in its nature and falls into a multitude of clearly defined types, each mixing together with others to form greater and more complex types of essentia.
i am not quite sure if the matter it is bound to gives essentia its nature, or that the very nature of matter depends on the essentia it contains. this bears further study.
i am keeping a log of all the types of essentia i discover. a bookmark on the left will show my current knowledge.
for now i need to focus my energies elsewhere. studying essentia might be a good place to start.
research.FIRSTSTEPS.title: First steps
research.FLUX.stage.1:
